function_specs.name: CriticalAreaLock
function_specs.meaning: Acquire current observed OS resources under the existing critical protocol.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaUnLock
function_specs.meaning: Return OS resources and restore the outside-critical state.

function_specs.name: x_malloc
function_specs.meaning: Return null or an aligned allocation; zero size returns null.

function_specs.name: memset
function_specs.meaning: Fill the owned byte range with the supplied byte.

function_specs.name: KSemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Existing IC create effect and updated OS invariant.

function_specs.name: DeInitDataqueue
function_specs.meaning: Existing init_cleanup contract retires an unpublished private queue.

function_specs.name: InitDataqueue
function_specs.meaning: Publish an empty initialized queue on success; on failure clean acquired resources and return the retired private structure.

loop_invariants.progress: Single-execution control wrapper with early failure breaks; no iterative state or added loop invariant.
